chars.ZINEB: ZINEB: a young Moroccan woman, 24, long dark wavy hair, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and light blue jeans
chars.SALMA: SALMA: a young Moroccan woman with a sleek black bob haircut and gold hoop earrings, wearing a red satin blouse and white wide-leg trousers
